Minus before a bracket: the parentheses the parser forgot

The parser keeps no parentheses, so a backend once wrote a unary operator straight before its first operand. Three conformance cases pin the fix: -(a + b), !(a and b) and ~(a | b).

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
